736730101.text: Greetings, welcome to the Citadel of Regzar.

736730102.text: This is where the Corps of Thirty get in touch with each other and coordinate. I can see from your outfit that you are not one of them...

736730103.text: Oh, I see, you came for the recruitment, right?

736730107.text: Very well then. I'll brief you on the gig in case it's not clear.

736730108.text: I am Effendi, a liaison sent by the Akademiya to coordinate the cooperation between the Akademiya and the Corps of Thirty.

736730109.text: You may have known that the Corps of Thirty is hired by the Akademiya to guard the whole Sumeru City.

736730110.text: They are additionally responsible for dealing with some problems residents encounter in daily life, which compounds their workload.

736730111.text: To ease the pressure, I decided to recruit an assistant after consulting with the Parchamdar.

736730112.text: You don't need to worry about city defense, just help us complete the residents' commissions.

736730113.text: As to the specifics, most of them are cumbersome and detailed. I'll elaborate with examples.

736730105.text: You came without having a look at it? Never mind, I'll explain.

736730201.text: That's the commission in general. It'd be great if you're willing and free to take it.

736730202.text: The logistics officer and I have agreed that you will be paid fairly for every gig you do.

736730203.text: Trivial as these commissions may be, I do hope you recognize the importance of this job.

736730204.text: You will be appreciated and respected by all who you have helped with their life.

736730205.text: If you stick to it, you'll surely heighten your Reputation among the residents, and they'll be more willing to accept you.

736730206.text: And I'll offer you more important and complicated jobs by then.

736730207.text: That's the general picture of this job. I hope you can think it over.

736730208.text: If you decide to take the job, feel free to register for the commissions.
